chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Sa'd ibn Abd Allah narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, from 'Amr ibn Marwan, from Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) who said:

Verily, for Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, are angels half of whom are of cold and half of whom are of fire. They say: 'O Combiner of Hot and Cold, keep our hearts firm in Your Obedience.' And I will bring out the traditions which I have narrated regarding the remembrance of the Greatness of Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, in the book 'Al-'Azamat', if Allah wills. Chapter: The Kindness of Allah, the Blessed and Exalted.
ai.seo_question: What do the angels made of cold and fire pray for?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the metaphysical composition of these angels, whose dual nature of cold and fire symbolizes the balance of divine attributes, to illustrate the profound humility required for steadfast obedience. This narration serves as a foundational link in the chapter on Allah’s greatness, emphasizing that even celestial beings seek divine assistance to maintain spiritual equilibrium. The mention of a separate book on 'Greatness' underscores the systematic theological approach of the early Shia scholars in categorizing divine attributes.
